verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments platform, so payout reconciliation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that payments can be listed and retrieved, and that transfers can be tested in Sandbox. Nothing documents a payout or balance-transaction (financial statement) endpoint, or any way to map a bank deposit back to the charges that make it up. Listing payments is a building block at most, not the reconciliation capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
